514. Weapon Power Sort

70

Hard  Topics

Problem Statement:
Thor wants to sort his weapons based on increasing value of its power to kill. The best coders in his team have done the task but are unable to sort the data in O(NlogN) time. Try to develop code that can sort the data in the required time complexity. Constraint: Power values lie between 0 and 10000
input_spec: Name of weapons with their power denoted beside it.
output_spec: Weapon named sorted in order of increasing power
